name: theme-enterprise
summary: Calm blue enterprise theme for Web and Admin: denser spacing, smaller radius, crisp borders.
description: Restyles the Web application and the Admin Console through design tokens only: a calm blue primary and brand, cool neutral surfaces, opaque crisp borders, a 0.375rem radius, a 4% denser Tailwind spacing unit, and less translucent Admin material. Light and dark mode are both covered and every checked readable pair meets WCAG AA 4.5:1. No component changes; remove the plugin to return to the default tokens.
use_when: the product is a business or internal tool and should look calm, trustworthy, and information dense
the builder asks for a corporate, enterprise, or blue look
tables and dashboards need slightly tighter spacing without changing components
